tasks.brief: Modify src/services/llm.py: Update stream_reply function signature to accept history parameter (Sequence[dict[str, str]] = ()). In the messages-array construction, insert history entries between system prompt and current user message. Read config from os.environ on each call (C-3). Yield only StreamChunk values. Acceptance: All M3 tests pass plus test_history_entries_in_upstream_messages, test_history_with_system_prompt_ordering, test_history_without_system_prompt_ordering, test_empty_history_matches_m3_behavior, test_multi_turn_history_preserves_all_entries, test_history_does_not_affect_streaming_behavior.

Modify src/api/chat.py: Add HistoryEntry pydantic model with role (Literal['user','assistant']) and content (str). Update ChatRequest to include optional history field (list[HistoryEntry], default []). In the POST /api/v1/chat handler, extract validated history from ChatRequest and pass it to stream_reply as plain dicts. Acceptance: All M3 tests pass plus test_chat_with_history_streams_correctly, test_chat_history_passed_to_upstream, test_chat_history_defaults_to_empty, test_chat_invalid_history_role_is_422, test_chat_history_missing_fields_is_422, test_chat_history_missing_role_is_422, test_chat_empty_history_array_is_valid, test_chat_history_with_system_prompt_ordering.

Modify src/static/index.html: Add JS code to maintain an in-memory conversation array. On successful turn (done event), append both user message and accumulated assistant response to the array. On failed turn (error event), do not add anything. Send conversation array as history in every POST request body. On page reload, reset array to []. Acceptance: test_root_serves_html_page passes, test_page_wires_chat_endpoint passes. Smoke check: Manual verification that multi-turn conversation persists across requests and resets on reload.
tasks.smoke_check: Manual: Submit multiple messages in sequence, verify conversation array grows correctly; reload page, verify history resets to empty.
